name: AgentReady Woo — evidence-led WooCommerce release gate
description: A passive public WooCommerce preflight plus an owner-authorized release gate. Public checks return reason-coded evidence or abstain when a store cannot be measured. The release gate uses version-pinned protocol fixtures and signed aggregate-only WordPress plugin evidence; it does not receive customer, order, payment, product-description, credential, or raw-log data. Release Gate settlement is currently disabled. A separate store-bound commerce surface remains available to authenticated merchants and does not imply Release Gate entitlement.
target_user: WooCommerce store owners and WordPress agencies deciding whether an agent-facing release is ready to ship.

tools.name: agentready_woo_agentic_commerce_readiness_toolkit_for_self_h
tools.description: Run a public WooCommerce readiness scan or protocol preflight, or an owner-authorized version-pinned release verification. Unreadable evidence produces an abstention rather than a fabricated score.

endpoints.description: Run the canonical AgentReady Woo readiness and release-gate surface. Use the published MCP and OpenAPI contracts for the five current tools.

pricing.note: The public scan and preflight are free. Release Gate settlement is disabled and no Release Gate entitlement is currently sold. Separate commerce plans are documented at /commerce and do not grant Release Gate access.
